_about: THE FINAL GOD LIST (owner, Oct 26, 2026): 100 new pages for the most Google traffic in the next 12 months, 10 a day from Oct 27. Priority = Google Trends US volume x page-type weight (bites 1.3, sorters 1.25, look-alikes/life stages/droppings 1.2, species 0.9, X vs Y 0.8) x winnability from a page-one screen (0.15 + 0.85 x w/10) x sqrt(Ahrefs KD factor); garden pests x0.75. Dropped: page one owned by institutions/medical/encyclopedias (winnability <= 2) unless the search is enormous, and searches under ~2,000/month. Release order = priority x winter factor (winter demand first). Page-one screen = WebSearch (approximates Google US), top 5 classified A institutions / B big brands / C beatable.
